announcement.title: Scarlet 0.6.0 — stable release
announcement.message:
Scarlet 0.6.0 brings the current fixes into the stable release series.

What's improved:
• Moderation summaries use saved local history and run in the background.
• Audit delivery retries and API request pacing have been improved.
• Close-instance commands handle full links and explain outcomes more clearly.
• Saving and permission checks have stronger protections.
• Automatic relaunch requires verified client ownership and normal shutdown.

Before updating:
• Keep an independent backup and close the old Scarlet process.
• Java 21 is recommended.
• If login fails temporarily, do not choose to reset your saved data.
• Read the release notes for requirements, known issues, and test limits.

Use Open link for the release notes and downloads.
